FORM.notes: source note: IU1中的 HANG 為發語詞，常出現在最開始的部分。 | source note: lacul現今衍伸為部落的產業。 | source note: bubu 為籠子；而籃子為kanas。

S.FORM: hang izaw kya cacay a wawa za izaw ku nicakepan nuheni tu balaut palaculen niza i tiza i bubu.
S.PHON: ħaŋ izaw kja ʦaʦaj a wawa za izaw ku niʦakəpan nuħəni tu ba[r|ɾ]aut pa[r|ɾ]aʦu[r|ɾ]ən niza i tiza i bubu
S.FORM: hang izaw kya cacay a wawa za izaw ku nicakepan nuheni tu balaut palaculen niza i tiza i bubu.
S.PHON: ħaŋ izaw kja ʦaʦaj a wawa za izaw ku niʦakəpan nuħəni tu ba[r|ɾ]aut pa[r|ɾ]aʦu[r|ɾ]ən niza i tiza i bubu
S.TRANSL: 有一個小孩抓到一隻青蛙,放到籃子中.
There was a child, and he caught a frog and put it in a basket.

FORM.notes: source note: azih 是看；cekul 往下看；mi-taang a mi-azih抬頭看。 | source note: iza為izaw的縮寫，是存在詞。

S.FORM: iza kya balaut i labu cekulentu nya wacu.
S.PHON: iza kja ba[r|ɾ]aut i [r|ɾ]abu ʦəku[r|ɾ]əntu nja waʦu
S.FORM: iza kya balaut i labu cekulentu nya wacu.
S.PHON: iza kja ba[r|ɾ]aut i [r|ɾ]abu ʦəku[r|ɾ]əntu nja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 狗往下看著在裡頭的青蛙.
The dog looked down on the frog, which was inside of a cage.

FORM.notes: source note: kyai 為 kyami的縮寫。

S.FORM: maidih kyai kya wacu a mukan tya balaut.
S.PHON: maidiħ kjai kja waʦu a mukan tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: maidih kyai kya wacu a mukan tya balaut.
S.PHON: maidiħ kjai kja waʦu a mukan tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 那隻狗可能想吃那隻青蛙吧!
That dog might want to eat that frog.

S.FORM: mabi' satu kya kya wawa a tya wacu.
S.PHON: mabi[ʔ|ʡ] satu kja kja wawa a tja waʦu
S.FORM: mabi' satu kya kya wawa a tya wacu.
S.PHON: mabi[ʔ|ʡ] satu kja kja wawa a tja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 小孩跟狗在睡覺.
That child and the dog were sleeping.

FORM.notes: source note: 看到在此應是指說故事的人，而非小孩及狗。 | source note: hekal 外面；tahkal到外面。

S.FORM: meya melaw hantu kya balaut mutahkal kya balaut mulaliw.
S.PHON: mea mə[r|ɾ]aw ħantu kja ba[r|ɾ]aut mutaħka[r|ɾ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw
S.FORM: meya melaw hantu kya balaut mutahkal kya balaut mulaliw.
S.PHON: mea mə[r|ɾ]aw ħantu kja ba[r|ɾ]aut mutaħka[r|ɾ] kja ba[r|ɾ]aut mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw
S.TRANSL: (我們)看到那隻青蛙跑掉了.
(We saw) that frog ran away.

S.FORM: matalaw nima ku lubuan nanaytu kaku a sa kyai kya balucu' mulaliw kya balaut.
S.PHON: mata[r|ɾ]aw nima ku [r|ɾ]ubuan nanajtu kaku a sa kjai kja ba[r|ɾ]uʦu[ʔ|ʡ] mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: matalaw nima ku lubuan nanaytu kaku a sa kyai kya balucu' mulaliw kya balaut.
S.PHON: mata[r|ɾ]aw nima ku [r|ɾ]ubuan nanajtu kaku a sa kjai kja ba[r|ɾ]uʦu[ʔ|ʡ] mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 那隻青蛙心想會一直被關就跑走了.
That frog thought that it would be confined and then ran away.

S.FORM: macukat satu kya wawa.
S.PHON: maʦukat satu kja wawa
S.FORM: macukat satu kya wawa.
S.PHON: maʦukat satu kja wawa
S.TRANSL: 小孩醒來了.
That child woke up.

FORM.notes: source note: tu aca 為慣用語意思為原來或結果。

S.FORM: nayitu aca kya balaut.
S.PHON: najitu aʦa kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: nayitu aca kya balaut.
S.PHON: najitu aʦa kja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 原來青蛙不見了.
It turned out that the frog disappeared.

S.FORM: aya nayitu kya balaut sa kya wawa a tya wacu.
S.PHON: aja najitu kja ba[r|ɾ]aut sa kja wawa a tja waʦu
S.FORM: aya nayitu kya balaut sa kya wawa a tya wacu.
S.PHON: aja najitu kja ba[r|ɾ]aut sa kja wawa a tja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 孩子對狗說:＂青蛙不見了.＂
That child said to the dog that the frog disappeared.

S.FORM: mikilimtu kuheni sa.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]imtu kuħəni sa
S.FORM: mikilimtu kuheni sa.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]imtu kuħəni sa
S.TRANSL: 他們去找(青蛙).
They searched for (frog).

FORM.notes: source note: kucu為日語外來語，漢字寫成靴(k^ts^)

S.FORM: tuhtuhen niza ku ku ku kucu niza mituhtuh.
S.PHON: tuħtuħən niza ku ku ku kuʦu niza mituħtuħ
S.FORM: tuhtuhen niza ku ku ku kucu niza mituhtuh.
S.PHON: tuħtuħən niza ku ku ku kuʦu niza mituħtuħ
S.TRANSL: 他把鞋子倒過來.
He placed the shoes upside down.

S.FORM: mumuktu i tiza pabubuan kya wacu mikilim tya balaut.
S.PHON: mumuktu i tiza pabubuan kja waʦu miki[r|ɾ]im tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: mumuktu i tiza pabubuan kya wacu mikilim tya balaut.
S.PHON: mumuktu i tiza pabubuan kja waʦu miki[r|ɾ]im tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 狗鑽進籠中去找青蛙.
That dog got into the cage to find the frog.

FORM.notes: source note: 根據發音人mi-awaw-en 在此不合語法，正確的形式應為 awaw-en。

S.FORM: miawawen nya hiya nya wawa.
S.PHON: miawawən nja ħija nja wawa
S.FORM: miawawen nya hiya nya wawa.
S.PHON: miawawən nja ħija nja wawa
S.TRANSL: 那小孩呼喊著.
That child yelled.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-cebu’ 跳到水裡。 | source note: halu-kaku 連(甚至)我，halu-kaku-kaku 意思較halu-kaku(連我) 更強烈

S.FORM: kina cu kina bulubulut satu kya wacu kina cebucebu' satu haluwacuwacu satu a maidih a mulaliw.
S.PHON: kina ʦu kina bu[r|ɾ]ubu[r|ɾ]ut satu kja waʦu kina ʦəbuʦəbu[ʔ|ʡ] satu ħa[r|ɾ]uwaʦuwaʦu satu a maidiħ a mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw
S.FORM: kina cu kina bulubulut satu kya wacu kina cebucebu' satu haluwacuwacu satu a maidih a mulaliw.
S.PHON: kina ʦu kina bu[r|ɾ]ubu[r|ɾ]ut satu kja waʦu kina ʦəbuʦəbu[ʔ|ʡ] satu ħa[r|ɾ]uwaʦuwaʦu satu a maidiħ a mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw
S.TRANSL: 連狗都想衝出去及跳進水裡.
Even the dog sprang and wanted to plunge into water.

FORM.notes: source note: tu aca 為慣用語意思為原來或結果。 | source note: mi-kilim 及ma-kilim 為中部、南勢阿美語的用法。mi-kilim=tu表示「去找了」；ma-kilim=tu表示「找到了」；mu-kilim tu tu wacu則是不合語法。 | source note: ma-tepa (沒有mi-tepa) 為北勢阿美語的用法；ma-tepa=tu表示「找到了」。

S.FORM: mikilimtu aca kya wawa tya wacu matepatu niza kya wacu.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]imtu aʦa kja wawa tja waʦu matəpatu niza kja waʦu
S.FORM: mikilimtu aca kya wawa tya wacu matepatu niza kya wacu.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]imtu aʦa kja wawa tja waʦu matəpatu niza kja waʦu
S.TRANSL: 小孩要去找狗了, 結果他找到那隻狗.
The child searched for that dog and he found it.

FORM.notes: source note: tu aca 為慣用語意思為原來或結果。

S.FORM: abibi han niza kya wacu initu aca kina wacu sa.
S.PHON: abibi ħan niza kja waʦu initu aʦa kina waʦu sa
S.FORM: abibi han niza kya wacu initu aca kina wacu sa.
S.PHON: abibi ħan niza kja waʦu initu aʦa kina waʦu sa
S.TRANSL: 他抱著狗, 原來狗在這.
He held the dog, which was here formerly.

S.FORM: mikilim henay kya wacu tya E balaut.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]im ħənaj kja waʦu tja ə ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: mikilim henay kya wacu tya E balaut.
S.PHON: miki[r|ɾ]im ħənaj kja waʦu tja ə ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 那隻狗還在找青蛙.
That dog was still looking for the frog.

FORM.notes: source note: hekal 外面 ta-hekal到外面。

S.FORM: ya balaut miawawtu kuheni tahkaltu kuheni mikilim tya balaut.
S.PHON: ja ba[r|ɾ]aut miawawtu kuħəni taħka[r|ɾ]tu kuħəni miki[r|ɾ]im tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: ya balaut miawawtu kuheni tahkaltu kuheni mikilim tya balaut.
S.PHON: ja ba[r|ɾ]aut miawawtu kuħəni taħka[r|ɾ]tu kuħəni miki[r|ɾ]im tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 他們呼喚著, 他們走出去找青蛙.
They yelled and went out to search for frog.

S.FORM: mamelawtu niza ku E tatekuh.
S.PHON: mamə[r|ɾ]awtu niza ku ə tatəkuħ
S.FORM: mamelawtu niza ku E tatekuh.
S.PHON: mamə[r|ɾ]awtu niza ku ə tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 他看到虎頭蜂.
He saw hornets.

S.FORM: makatengil ku tatekuh tahkaltu tu tu makatengiltu nipiawaw nuheni tya tya pikilim nuheni tya balaut.
S.PHON: makatəŋi[r|ɾ] ku tatəkuħ taħka[r|ɾ]tu tu tu makatəŋi[r|ɾ]tu nipiawaw nuħəni tja tja piki[r|ɾ]im nuħəni tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.FORM: makatengil ku tatekuh tahkaltu tu tu makatengiltu nipiawaw nuheni tya tya pikilim nuheni tya balaut.
S.PHON: makatəŋi[r|ɾ] ku tatəkuħ taħka[r|ɾ]tu tu tu makatəŋi[r|ɾ]tu nipiawaw nuħəni tja tja piki[r|ɾ]im nuħəni tja ba[r|ɾ]aut
S.TRANSL: 虎頭蜂聽到他們出來尋找青蛙的呼喚聲.
Hornets heard sounds made by the child and the dog when they were searching for the frog.

S.FORM: makamelaw kya wacu tya tya hiya tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: makamə[r|ɾ]aw kja waʦu tja tja ħija tja tatəkuħ
S.FORM: makamelaw kya wacu tya tya hiya tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: makamə[r|ɾ]aw kja waʦu tja tja ħija tja tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 狗看到虎頭蜂.
The dog saw hornets.

FORM.notes: source note: tatekuh 在此指虎頭蜂的蜂窩 | source note: IU 37中SA-PI- -PF 為句型，意思為「想要」，sa-當作參考焦點。

S.FORM: E sapizawisen ciniza tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: ə sapizawisən ʦiniza tja tatəkuħ
S.FORM: E sapizawisen ciniza tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: ə sapizawisən ʦiniza tja tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 狗想摘蜂窩.
The dog wanted to pluck the beehives.

FORM.notes: source note: mehan 為 melaw han 看到的縮寫。

S.FORM: mehantu kya hiya kya wawa misusu' tu buhang.
S.PHON: məħantu kja ħija kja wawa misusu[ʔ|ʡ] tu buħaŋ
S.FORM: mehantu kya hiya kya wawa misusu' tu buhang.
S.PHON: məħantu kja ħija kja wawa misusu[ʔ|ʡ] tu buħaŋ
S.TRANSL: 那小孩被看到把手放到洞中.
It was seen that the child put his hand inside of the hole.

FORM.notes: source note: 老鼠為edu；kalabaw 則為田鼠，卑南族也稱為kalabaw。

S.FORM: mitahkal satu u kalabaw kyai u kalabaw.
S.PHON: mitaħka[r|ɾ] satu u ka[r|ɾ]abaw kjai u ka[r|ɾ]abaw
S.FORM: mitahkal satu u kalabaw kyai u kalabaw.
S.PHON: mitaħka[r|ɾ] satu u ka[r|ɾ]abaw kjai u ka[r|ɾ]abaw
S.TRANSL: 出來的可能是田鼠.
What came out might be voles.

FORM.notes: source note: pising為阿美族語；撒奇萊雅語則為bihid。

S.FORM: izaw kya kalabaw makalat nya kalabaw ku pising nya wawa.
S.PHON: izaw kja ka[r|ɾ]abaw maka[r|ɾ]at nja ka[r|ɾ]abaw ku pisiŋ nja wawa
S.FORM: izaw kya kalabaw makalat nya kalabaw ku pising nya wawa.
S.PHON: izaw kja ka[r|ɾ]abaw maka[r|ɾ]at nja ka[r|ɾ]abaw ku pisiŋ nja wawa
S.TRANSL: 有田鼠而且咬了小孩的臉.
There was a vole, which bit the face of the child.

FORM.notes: source note: tatekuh 在此指虎頭蜂蜂窩。

S.FORM: kya wacu maidih mikalic ni mizawis tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: kja waʦu maidiħ mika[r|ɾ]iʦ ni mizawis tja tatəkuħ
S.FORM: kya wacu maidih mikalic ni mizawis tya tatekuh.
S.PHON: kja waʦu maidiħ mika[r|ɾ]iʦ ni mizawis tja tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 那隻狗想爬上去摘虎頭蜂蜂窩.
That dog wanted to climbed up and pluck the beehives.

FORM.notes: source note: na=mu-kan kya kayabes 表示曾吃過或吃完Kayabes。 | source note: mi-zawis 動作向上的摘；mi-ala 拿；mi-pecu’ 摘；mi-picpic 用手指摘(nip)。

S.FORM: sabeleng satu kya tatekuh namizawis kya wa wacu.
S.PHON: sabə[r|ɾ]əŋ satu kja tatəkuħ namizawis kja wa waʦu
S.FORM: sabeleng satu kya tatekuh namizawis kya wa wacu.
S.PHON: sabə[r|ɾ]əŋ satu kja tatəkuħ namizawis kja wa waʦu
S.TRANSL: 那隻狗摘蜂窩, 一群蜜蜂飛過來.
That dog wanted to pluck the beehives and there came a swarm of hornets.

S.FORM: iza kya E u hiya u edu mutahkal.
S.PHON: iza kja ə u ħija u ədu mutaħka[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: iza kya E u hiya u edu mutahkal.
S.PHON: iza kja ə u ħija u ədu mutaħka[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 一隻老鼠跑出來.
There came out a mouse.

S.FORM: E ya han kya wawa mukilim tya edu.
S.PHON: ə ja ħan kja wawa muki[r|ɾ]im tja ədu
S.FORM: E ya han kya wawa mukilim tya edu.
S.PHON: ə ja ħan kja wawa muki[r|ɾ]im tja ədu
S.TRANSL: 那小孩找老鼠.
That child searched for the mouse.

FORM.notes: source note: i cuwatu 的縮寫為catu。 | source note: ta-tuay 為tala-cuwa的縮寫形。 | source note: kyai 原意為「或許」，在此為疑問助詞。

S.FORM: tatuay sa kyai han melaw han sa ini i sasa kya edu.
S.PHON: tatuaj sa kjai ħan mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan sa ini i sasa kja ədu
S.FORM: tatuay sa kyai han melaw han sa ini i sasa kya edu.
S.PHON: tatuaj sa kjai ħan mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan sa ini i sasa kja ədu
S.TRANSL: 他以為(老鼠)去哪裡,結果老鼠在下面.
He wondered where the mouse was, and it was under there.

S.FORM: mikalic kya wawa a tya mimelaw tya buhang nya kilang.
S.PHON: mika[r|ɾ]iʦ kja wawa a tja mimə[r|ɾ]aw tja buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.FORM: mikalic kya wawa a tya mimelaw tya buhang nya kilang.
S.PHON: mika[r|ɾ]iʦ kja wawa a tja mimə[r|ɾ]aw tja buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: 小孩爬上樹要看樹洞.
That child climbed up to see the tree hole.

FORM.notes: source note: tu aca 為慣用語意思為原來或結果

S.FORM: mapulintu aca melaw han sa izaw ku ayam i labu nya buhang nya ayam.
S.PHON: mapu[r|ɾ]intu aʦa mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan sa izaw ku ajam i [r|ɾ]abu nja buħaŋ nja ajam
S.FORM: mapulintu aca melaw han sa izaw ku ayam i labu nya buhang nya ayam.
S.PHON: mapu[r|ɾ]intu aʦa mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan sa izaw ku ajam i [r|ɾ]abu nja buħaŋ nja ajam
S.TRANSL: 跌倒之後看到樹洞裡有鳥.
(He) fell down and saw birds in the tree hole.

S.FORM: matawid kyai kya wawa mapulin ma matienang.
S.PHON: matawid kjai kja wawa mapu[r|ɾ]in ma matiənaŋ
S.FORM: matawid kyai kya wawa mapulin ma matienang.
S.PHON: matawid kjai kja wawa mapu[r|ɾ]in ma matiənaŋ
S.TRANSL: 小孩可能被嚇到之後跌倒,跌得四腳朝天.
It might be that the child was shocked and fell on his back.

S.FORM: i u yu tahkal sa kya ayam i tiza i i buhang nya kilang.
S.PHON: i u ju taħka[r|ɾ] sa kja ajam i tiza i i buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.FORM: i u yu tahkal sa kya ayam i tiza i i buhang nya kilang.
S.PHON: i u ju taħka[r|ɾ] sa kja ajam i tiza i i buħaŋ nja ki[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: 小鳥從樹洞出來.
A bird came out of the tree hole.

S.FORM: melaw han u deku' u deku'.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan u dəku[ʔ|ʡ] u dəku[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: melaw han u deku' u deku'.
S.PHON: mə[r|ɾ]aw ħan u dəku[ʔ|ʡ] u dəku[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: (他們)看到貓頭鷹.
(They) see owls.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-tuba’ 跑。

S.FORM: kina wacu mulaliw lalaba'en nu tatekuh.
S.PHON: kina waʦu mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aba[ʔ|ʡ]ən nu tatəkuħ
S.FORM: kina wacu mulaliw lalaba'en nu tatekuh.
S.PHON: kina waʦu mu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iw [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aba[ʔ|ʡ]ən nu tatəkuħ
S.TRANSL: 狗跑去追虎頭蜂.
That dog ran away and was chased by hornets.

S.FORM: makamelaw kya ayam tya wawa.
S.PHON: makamə[r|ɾ]aw kja ajam tja wawa
S.FORM: makamelaw kya ayam tya wawa.
S.PHON: makamə[r|ɾ]aw kja ajam tja wawa
S.TRANSL: 那隻鳥能看得到那個孩子.
The bird could see that child.

FORM.notes: source note: sa-pi-...-en 為參考焦點句型，意思為「想要」。

S.FORM: sapikalatan kya ayam tya wawa u sapikalatan kina deku' nahiya tina wawa.
S.PHON: sapika[r|ɾ]atan kja ajam tja wawa u sapika[r|ɾ]atan kina dəku[ʔ|ʡ] naħija tina wawa
S.FORM: sapikalatan kya ayam tya wawa u sapikalatan kina deku' nahiya tina wawa.
S.PHON: sapika[r|ɾ]atan kja ajam tja wawa u sapika[r|ɾ]atan kina dəku[ʔ|ʡ] naħija tina wawa
